node.statement: Uniform coarse norm bounds. Fix n and put a_i=v_{i,n}(X_i). Since v_i are extended t-inclusions, (1-t)||X_i||<=||a_i||<=(1+t)||X_i||. Thus ||V_n(X)||<=2(1+t)||X||. Conversely node 1.1 gives ||a_i||<=||C_ii V_n(X)||+K_geo*t*max_j||a_j||<=K_geo||V_n(X)||+K_geo*t*max_j||a_j||. Taking the maximum and t<=1/(2K_geo) yields max_i||a_i||<=2K_geo||V_n(X)||, whence ||V_n(X)||>=(1-t)(2K_geo)^{-1}||X||. After reducing the threshold, fixed universal c=(4K_geo)^{-1} and C=3 satisfy c||X||<=||V_n(X)||<=C||X|| simultaneously for all n.
